mostWorthwhile.text: The collagen sequence was most worthwhile: it connected gene activity and protein synthesis to secretion and assembly of material supporting cells outside the membrane.

leastWorthwhile.text: The muscle branch repeated the message-to-protein pattern already shown for collagen, although the comparison served the chapter's purpose.

surprise.text: The supporting matrix formed outside living fibroblasts, with secreted precursors processed into fibres in a hydrated gel; tissue includes that extracellular material as well as cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining fibroblasts with extracellular fluid was an abstract way to represent secretion and assembly rather than a literal mixing action.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the separate muscle precursors develop further, although the available choices here were mostly straightforward.
